The following Act of Parliament received the assent of the President on the
20th December, 2007, and is hereby published for general information:—

THE SASHASTRA SEEMA BAL ACT, 2007
NO. 53 OF 2007
[20th December, 2007.]
An Act to provide for the constitution and regulation of an armed force of the
Union for ensuring the security of the borders of India and for matters
connected therewith.

BE it enacted by Parliament in the Fifty-eighth Year of the Republic of India as follows:—

CHAPTER I

PRELIMINARY

commencement.
